objective: Prevent Object.prototype pollution from supplying or executing inherited MapCommand v2 fields by rebuilding validated own-property command data before Zod parsing.

defect.summary: The plain-data boundary inspected only own properties and then piped the original Object.prototype-backed object into Zod. Polluted inherited required fields could therefore satisfy command schemas, and inherited getters could execute during Zod parsing.
defect.rootCause: plainCommandDataV2Schema was validation-only. Its pipe output was the original input rather than a safe own-property-only tree.

implementation.summary: The boundary now rebuilds the complete validated tree using property descriptors and passes only that rebuilt tree to Zod.
implementation.recordPolicy: Accept Object.prototype-backed plain objects and null-prototype records only; rebuild both as null-prototype records containing only own enumerable data properties.
implementation.arrayPolicy: Accept only Array.prototype arrays with an intrinsic data length, dense canonical indices, and no extra, symbol, non-enumerable, or accessor properties; rebuild indices with data descriptors.
implementation.getterPolicy: Never read input fields through ordinary property lookup, spread, or Object.assign. Descriptor values are the only copied values.
implementation.graphPolicy: Use an active-object WeakSet to reject real cycles and a rebuilt-object WeakMap to preserve repeated non-circular references.
implementation.mutationPolicy: Never write to the input tree. All Zod parsing receives newly allocated records and arrays.
